newsitem.title: USA: Allergan sees exchange rates hurting Q2, yr.
newsitem.headline: Allergan sees exchange rates hurting Q2, yr.

text.p: Allergan Inc said Wednesday unfavorable exchange rates accounted for about half the drop in its first quarter earnings and are expected to hurt second quarter and full-year results.
The company said its results were also hurt by the costs of launching new products and continuing competitive pressures on the eye care business.
Worldwide sales from the company's eyecare pharmaceutical business totaled $93.3 million in the first quarter compared with $98 million in the year-ago period.
